<section class="resources-section">

    <div class="resource-grid">
      <div class="resource-card">
        <h3>Repositories Overview</h3>
        <p class="resource-description">
          This page lists all GitHub repositories containing golf biomechanics models, simulations, 
          data processing tools, and related software. Each repository covers a different aspect 
          of biomechanical modeling, control theory, and golf swing analysis. Click any repository
          to expand its details.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="accordion-item">
        <button class="accordion-header" type="button" aria-expanded="false">
          <span>Golf Model (3D)</span>
          <span class="accordion-icon" aria-hidden="true">+</span>
        </button>
        <div class="accordion-content">
          <p class="resource-description">
            MATLAB-based biomechanical modeling and simulation system for analyzing golf swing dynamics, 
            trajectory optimization, and performance metrics. The system includes tools for modeling 
            using MATLAB/Simulink Simscape Multibody, motion capture data analysis, dataset generation, interactive 
            GUI applications, and Python-based utilities for data processing and visualization.
          </p>
          <a href="repositories-3d-model.html" class="resource-link">View Details →</a>
          <a href="https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="resource-link u-ml-2">View on GitHub →</a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="accordion-item">
        <button class="accordion-header" type="button" aria-expanded="false">
          <span>2D Golf Model</span>
          <span class="accordion-icon" aria-hidden="true">+</span>
        </button>
        <div class="accordion-content">
          <p class="resource-description">
            Two-dimensional golf swing model for simplified analysis and visualization of golf swing dynamics. 
            The model offers a streamlined approach to fundamental biomechanical principles with reduced 
            computational complexity.
          </p>
          <a href="repositories-2d-model.html" class="resource-link">View Details →</a>
          <a href="https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="resource-link u-ml-2">View on GitHub →</a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="accordion-item">
        <button class="accordion-header" type="button" aria-expanded="false">
          <span>Drake Golf Model</span>
          <span class="accordion-icon" aria-hidden="true">+</span>
        </button>
        <div class="accordion-content">
          <p class="resource-description">
            Golf swing models and simulations implemented using Drake, an open-source toolbox from MIT's Robot 
            Locomotion Group. These models focus on underactuated systems, manipulation, and control-affine dynamics for 
            golf biomechanics analysis.
          </p>
          <a href="repositories-drake.html" class="resource-link">View Details →</a>
          <a href="https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="resource-link u-ml-2">View on GitHub →</a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="accordion-item">
        <button class="accordion-header" type="button" aria-expanded="false">
          <span>Pinocchio Golf Model</span>
          <span class="accordion-icon" aria-hidden="true">+</span>
        </button>
        <div class="accordion-content">
          <p class="resource-description">
            Rigid body dynamics and kinematics models using Pinocchio for golf swing analysis. They cover 
            forward/inverse dynamics, Jacobian computations, and constraint handling for multibody systems 
            in golf biomechanics.
          </p>
          <a href="repositories-pinocchio.html" class="resource-link">View Details →</a>
          <a href="https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="resource-link u-ml-2">View on GitHub →</a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="accordion-item">
        <button class="accordion-header" type="button" aria-expanded="false">
          <span>MuJoCo Golf Swing Model</span>
          <span class="accordion-icon" aria-hidden="true">+</span>
        </button>
        <div class="accordion-content">
          <p class="resource-description">
            Physics-based golf swing simulations using MuJoCo (Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact) for biomechanical 
            analysis. MuJoCo simulates physics quickly and accurately for model-based optimization and analysis of 
            golf swing dynamics.
          </p>
          <a href="../models/models-mujoco.html" class="resource-link">View Details →</a>
          <a href="https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="resource-link u-ml-2">View on GitHub →</a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="accordion-item">
        <button class="accordion-header" type="button" aria-expanded="false">
          <span>Pendulum Golf Models</span>
          <span class="accordion-icon" aria-hidden="true">+</span>
        </button>
        <div class="accordion-content">
          <p class="resource-description">
            Pendulum-based models and simulations that serve as simplified analogs for understanding golf swing 
            dynamics. Single, double, and multi-link pendulum systems introduce control-affine 
            systems and drift-input decomposition.
          </p>
          <a href="../models/models-pendulum.html" class="resource-link">View Details →</a>
          <a href="https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="resource-link u-ml-2">View on GitHub →</a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="accordion-item">
        <button class="accordion-header" type="button" aria-expanded="false">
          <span>Data Processor</span>
          <span class="accordion-icon" aria-hidden="true">+</span>
        </button>
        <div class="accordion-content">
          <p class="resource-description">
            Tools and utilities for processing motion capture data, biomechanical measurements, and golf swing 
            analysis datasets. The toolkit handles data cleaning, transformation, and visualization.
          </p>
          <a href="https://github.com/D-sorganization/Data_Processor" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="resource-link">View on GitHub →</a>
        </div>

      <div class="accordion-item">
        <button class="accordion-header" type="button" aria-expanded="false">
          <span>Audio Processor</span>
          <span class="accordion-icon" aria-hidden="true">+</span>
        </button>
        <div class="accordion-content">
          <p class="resource-description">
            Audio processing tools for analyzing sound data related to golf swings, including impact sounds, 
            club dynamics, and acoustic feedback analysis.
          </p>
          <a href="https://github.com/D-sorganization/Audio_Processor" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="resource-link">View on GitHub →</a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="accordion-item">
        <button class="accordion-header" type="button" aria-expanded="false">
          <span>Video Processor</span>
          <span class="accordion-icon" aria-hidden="true">+</span>

        <div class="accordion-content">
          <p class="resource-description">
            Video processing and analysis tools for golf swing video data, including motion tracking, frame

          </p>
          <a href="https://github.com/D-sorganization/Video_Processor" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="resource-link">View on GitHub →</a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="accordion-item">
        <button class="accordion-header" type="button" aria-expanded="false">
